Referred Sections: Spondylolisthesis with Spondylolysis (e.g., Isthmic Spondylolisthesis) (TOC: S8.1.2)

Required findings: Imaging findings include EITHER dynamic segmental instability on flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of a supine and upright image with a difference in translational alignment between vertebrae >3mm between views, OR Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis at the requested level(s)
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs OR a provider-directed exercise program for at least three (3) consecutive months, unless contraindicated
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)

Documentation of nicotine-free status as a never-smoker, OR refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and/or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal range
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Degenerative Spondylolisthesis without Spondylolysis (TOC: S8.1.1)
